memory_update.text: SENEA should be tracked as a direct underfollowed private-label/contract-packaged shelf-stable and frozen food processor; verify customer concentration and private-label growth before promoting beyond Layer 1.

CALM maps to private-label/value-tier staples through egg production, grading, packaging, cold-chain distribution, and specialty/conventional private-label shell eggs; key risk is commodity egg-price and avian-flu cyclicality overwhelming the private-label thesis.

ODC is an adjacent private-label consumer-staples candidate via cat litter and absorbent products; it belongs in an underfollowed lane because the public-market label is specialty minerals rather than consumer private label.

For this node, retailer qualification, packaging formats, cold-chain or shelf-stable processing capacity, and customer-label production history are the key chokepoint variables to verify across candidates.

TreeHouse Foods is a strong historical reference for private-label food manufacturing, but current US-listed status must be verified before inclusion in any investable universe; avoid using it as an active candidate until listing status is confirmed.

node: Private-label and value-tier consumer staples contract manufacturing
summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around less-obvious public beneficiaries of private-label/value-tier consumer staples. The most relevant underfollowed lane includes narrow manufacturers and processors whose plants, food-safety processes, retailer qualification history, packaging formats, and category-specific capacity may make them harder to replace than their generic industry labels imply. The list deliberately avoids mega-cap retailers and focuses on US-listed manufacturers with private-label, customer-label, co-manufacturing, grocery, club, foodservice, or value-staples exposure.
